jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.description:
Your Company:

As the Nonprofit Marketing Platform trusted by over 1,300 nonprofits, Feathr is purpose-built to help our customers unlock more results, time, and confidence.

Feathr's software marketing platform equips nonprofits with the tools they need to build purposeful connections with their community and grow impact with confidence.

We're working on building an amazing culture at Feathr, where amazing people (like you) can do their best work. If you're ready to grow and "help the helpers" you've come to the right place.

VP of Engineering

Salary Range
: $200,000- $250,000 annually

Additional Compensation
: Annual performance bonus + Equity

Benefits
: Fully Remote, Health/ dental/ vision, Paid Vacation/ sick/ holidays

Your Work:

The VP of Engineering at Feathr leads our Engineering teams as we focus on refining, hardening, and improving our existing product — not scaling headcount or chasing rapid growth. This is a maturity and craftsmanship role: you'll drive a technology vision centered on usability, reliability, and customer experience, and you'll build the management structure and technical rigor needed to sustain a healthy, high-quality product over the long run.

You'll work closely with our tech leads to raise the bar on execution, mentorship, and process, while staying closely connected to the day-to-day work of the team. You'll be a thought partner to the CEO on where and how engineering investment should go to improve the product our customers already rely on.

Your Experience:

6+ years of engineering leadership experience, ideally including time leading through a mature/steady-state product phase (not just hypergrowth)
10+ years of formal software development experience
Experience developing tech leads into engineering managers, or building a management layer where none previously existed
Experience driving the adoption, rollout, and governance of AI coding tools across engineering teams and managing impact metrics, and genuinely excited to lead the team into its next chapter with agentic AI
Deep knowledge of modern software architecture, cloud infrastructure, and development practices
Track record improving product quality, performance, or usability in an established codebase, not just shipping net-new features
B2B SaaS experience strongly preferred; MarTech or adjacent verticals a plus

Your Qualities:

Motivated by refinement and craftsmanship, not just growth for its own sake. Takes real satisfaction in making an existing product better.
Comfortable operating without a management layer already in place; can coach and develop tech leads.
Balances strategic thinking with hands-on involvement. Comfortable in architecture and code-quality discussions as well as roadmap planning.
Instinctively connects engineering decisions back to customer experience and usability outcomes.
Uses quality, reliability, and customer-experience metrics to guide priorities, not just velocity.
Pragmatic, organized, and detail-oriented, with the judgment to know when "good enough" is right and when it isn't.
Strong communicator who can move fluidly between engineering, executive, and customer-facing audiences.

Your Day:

Partner with the CEO to define the technology vision and operating plan focused on product quality, usability, and customer experience
Identify and prioritize technical debt, performance, and reliability improvements alongside customer-facing enhancements
Build out engineering management capability by coaching and developing tech leads, and determine where formal management roles are needed
Oversee planning and execution of product refinements and upgrades, ensuring quality and service readiness
Own all managerial responsibilities for the org: budget, performance management, and career development for tech leads and the broader team
Define, track, and report on metrics that matter for a maturing product: defect rates, performance, uptime/reliability, support resolution time, and customer satisfaction
Balance individual customer needs and support escalations with broader product priorities
Collaborate daily with Product, Customer Success, Managed Services, and other cross-functional stakeholders
Define and continuously improve the technical support triage process and stakeholder touchpoints
Make judgment calls on where to invest limited engineering capacity for the highest customer impact
Participate in customer calls as needed to represent the technical perspective
Maintain clear documentation of engineering processes, decisions, and standards
Lead Feathr’s AI transformation. With Claude access already in place org-wide, you’ll turn that access into capability by shaping practices and standards that help the team build faster and better.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Compensation:

Annual base salary for this position is $200,000- $250,000 + bonus + equity

In addition, you’ll receive health/dental/vision insurance, and other benefits like a professional development budget, parental leave, and not to mention being a part of a supportive and motivated team.

Location:

This role is open to remote
candidates located within the United States
, with a preference for those in the EST
or CST
time zones.

Interview Process:

We're committed to a fair, transparent, and positive interview experience, so here's what to expect, including the time involved at each stage.

HR Information Screen - A 20–30 minute virtual conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to learn more about your background and answer initial questions.
CEO Interview - A 1-hour virtual conversation with our CEO to discuss vision, strategy, and mutual fit.
Tech Team Leadership Interview - Meet with members of our technical leadership team to dig into engineering approaches and priorities.
Panel Interview - A 60-minute session with two to three key team members, covering leadership style, collaboration, and role-specific scenarios.
Offer - If we're moving forward together, our Talent Acquisition team will reach out to walk through the offer details.

Interviewing at Feathr

We've prepared a comprehensive candidate resource that provides valuable insights and tips for interviewing at Feathr. It covers everything from common interview questions to helpful advice on how to make the most of your interview experience with us. Access the resource here.

We encourage all applicants to take advantage of this resource to help prepare for their interviews and gain a deeper understanding of what to expect when applying to join our Flock.

Benefits & Perks For Full-time Employees

We love our Flock and the work they do! But let’s be honest, life isn’t just about work. So we created a perks and benefits package that aims to help our team grow by including their wellness, families, passions, and personal time.

Fully remote
Full vision, dental, and ~99% health insurance for employees
Sick time off
Vacation time off
Extended Wintr Break
Parental Leave
Wellness Reimbursement Credit
Home Office Stipend
Professional Development Budget
Team hangouts and events

Culture:

Feathr defines culture as the secret sauce that makes our flock members want to come to work everyday and do their best work. Like every company, we have an acronym that conveys the most important aspects of the culture we strive to have.

Practicality: Progress Over Perfection
Ambition: When Feathr wins, We all win
Candor: Better communication, Better results
Trust: Assume the best, Share openly
Service: We exist to fix

This acronym is only as useful as the integrity of the people who reference it and believe in it. Every person at Feathr will face challenges, the most important quality is a commitment to work through those challenges with self-awareness and honesty.

Feathr is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, if you think you’d drive value in this position, please apply.

jobs.description:
Business Introduction

At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Find out more:

Our approach to R&D

At GSK we see a world in which advanced applications of machine learning and AI will allow us to develop novel therapies to existing diseases and to quickly respond to emerging or changing diseases with personalized drugs, driving better outcomes at reduced cost with fewer side effects. It is an ambitious vision that will require the development of products and solutions at the cutting edge of machine learning and AI. If that excites you, we'd love to chat.

We are looking for a Senior Director of AI/ML Engineering – Head of Engineering for World Models. This is a technical management track role with responsibility for building out a team in this domain. The candidate should be comfortable being accountable for setting the direction, standards, and culture of a machine learning engineering sub-team, with demonstrable expertise across machine learning, software engineering, computational pathology and medical imaging. Equally important will be excellent communication, interpersonal and organizational skills, and the ability to represent and transmit the values and principles of our AI/ML team. The AI/ML team is built on the principles of ownership, accountability, continuous development, and collaboration. We hire for the long term, and we're motivated to make this a great place to work. Our leaders will be committed to your career and development from day one.

As the Sr. Director of AI/ML Engineering you will
:

Lead a machine learning engineering team specializing in medical imaging and multimodal health data applications
Manage complex, multi-quarter, cross-functional projects
Be a standard bearer for data science and software engineering best practices
Develop plans to meet requirements, organize a team capable of executing the plans, and lead and track delivery.
Drive an interview process to enable team growth adhering to diversity and inclusion requirements
Maintain a safe and inclusive team environment in which people thrive
Operate in a transparent way, communicating clearly and accurately to leadership and the broader organization within the organization

Basic Qualifications
:

7+ years proficiency with standard deep learning algorithms and model architectures
Have developed a high-performing team through coaching, feedback and ensuring

3+ years' experience in a technical lead or engineering manager role with direct reports
7+ years' experience of professional software development practices: code standards, code review, version control, CI/CD, testing, documentation, Agile, with the ability to mentor others in these practices
10+ years Advanced Python programming skills

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with large language models
Experience working in AI/ML health applications
Track record as an independent contributor capable of end-to-end development of deployed products
Track record of delivering robust software solutions
In depth knowledge in machine learning best practices, scalable training and deployment
Experience working with biological sequence data (e.g. genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics)
ML-powered products for health applications

Skills

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Artificial Intelligence Ethics, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Classification Models, Deep Learning, Intelligent Automation (IA), Machine Learning (ML), Predictive Modeling, Python (Programming Language)

In addition, this position offers an annual bonus and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program which is dependent on the level of the role. Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. Why join Mad?

Joining Mad means you’ll be joining a team of creatives who treat every workday as an opportunity to learn and grow. We have a thriving in-person and vibrant virtual culture. We encourage collaboration, curiosity, and passion in order to make our clients stand out among their competitors.

Our culture is positive, flexible, inclusive, and engaging. We treat our space as a playground where we encourage you to test any creative ideas you’ve been wanting to try but never had the opportunity to. Working at Mad means being empowered to bring your unique perspective into every project, client production, the community, and the industry at large.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Director of Technology & Innovation
to lead Mad's dev team and help shape how we approach technology, development, and innovation across the agency. This is a leadership role for someone who understands technology deeply enough to guide technical teams and make informed decisions, while also being able to connect technology to business needs, client objectives, creative ideas, timelines, budgets, and operational realities.

The Director of Technology & Innovation will lead our development and technical team, working closely with Tech Leads, Developers, Project Managers, UX, Creative, Operations, and agency leadership. The role will also help Mad identify and implement emerging technologies, including AI, where they can improve our work, our internal operations, or the solutions we create for clients.

What You'll Do

You will lead Mad's Development team, providing direction, mentorship, and accountability while partnering with Tech Leads and Project Managers to ensure technology projects are properly scoped, resourced, and successfully delivered. You will help establish technical standards and make pragmatic decisions that balance quality, scalability, security, timelines, budgets, and client needs.

As Mad's senior technology representative, you will work directly with clients and senior technology stakeholders, translating complex technical topics into clear recommendations and building confidence in Mad's capabilities throughout the project lifecycle. You will also partner with agency leadership on active client relationships and new business opportunities, contributing to discovery, technical strategy, solution development, scoping, estimates, pitches, and presentations.

You will help shape the future of Mad's technology capabilities by identifying opportunities to improve how we work and expand what we offer. This includes evaluating emerging technologies such as AI and automation, strengthening collaboration across Technology, Creative, UX, Project Management, and Operations, and identifying innovative solutions that create meaningful value for Mad and our clients.

Skills Needed

10+ years of experience in technology, software development, digital products, technical delivery, or related fields, with meaningful experience in a leadership role.
Experience leading multidisciplinary technology teams and managing senior technical professionals.
Strong understanding of modern software development practices, web technologies, APIs, cloud platforms, data, integrations, and digital product development.
Enough technical depth to effectively challenge, guide, and support developers and technical leads without needing to personally own day-to-day coding.
Strong understanding of the full project lifecycle, from discovery and technical scoping through development, QA, launch, and ongoing support.
Proven experience managing multiple complex projects and priorities simultaneously.
Strong client-facing experience, including working directly with senior technology and business stakeholders.
Strong commercial and sales acumen, with the ability to understand client needs, shape solutions, communicate value, and contribute effectively to pitches and new business opportunities.
Executive presence and excellent communication skills, with the ability to establish credibility with both highly technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, accountability, performance management, and team development.
Strong business judgment and the ability to balance technical excellence with timelines, budgets, resources, and client needs.
Practical understanding of AI and emerging technologies and an interest in identifying where they can create meaningful business value.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift and teams must adapt quickly.

Experience working within an advertising agency, digital agency, creative technology studio, consultancy, or similarly fast-paced client-service environment.
Experience working with enterprise clients and senior technology stakeholders.
Experience with interactive installations, experiential technology, or other nontraditional digital experiences.

Experience founding or building a company from early stage

Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it’s the one thing you can’t get back - because it is. Company Description

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

Job Description

The Director, Platform SRO is a senior, hands-on technical leader responsible for ensuring the stability, resilience, and operational readiness of mission-critical broadcast linear, live event, and digital media platforms. Operating in high-pressure, real-time environments, this consultant leads major incident response efforts, supports on-air and live-event continuity, and partners closely with engineering, broadcast operations, production, and vendor teams to minimize service disruption and audience impact. The role requires deep practical experience with media workflows, rapid troubleshooting during live events, and the ability to make sound technical decisions under tight time constraints.

Beyond reactive incident response, the Director plays a strategic role in improving long-term system reliability and operational maturity. By applying SRO/SRE principles adapted for media environments, the consultant identifies systemic risks, drives root cause analysis, strengthens monitoring and observability, and improves operational processes across broadcast and digital ecosystems. This role balances immediate hands-on execution with advisory leadership, helping organizations build more resilient architectures, clearer incident processes, and greater confidence in their ability to support live, always-on media operations.

Responsibilities

Lead and coordinate high-severity incident response for broadcast linear channels, live events, and digital media platforms, serving as incident commander when required
Rapidly triage and troubleshoot issues across media workflows, including playout, live production, contribution/distribution, and OTT delivery
Establish, refine, and execute incident management processes, including escalation models, on-call coordination, communications, and severity classification
Produce post-incident reviews, root cause analyses, and corrective action plans to prevent recurrence and reduce operational risk
Assess system reliability, fault tolerance, and operational readiness across on-prem, hybrid, and cloud-based media architectures
Identify single points of failure and recommend architectural, workflow, and operational improvements to enhance availability and resilience
Define and improve monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies tailored to real-time broadcast and live event environments
Support disaster recovery, failover planning, and live-event readiness reviews, including testing and validation
Develop and maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, and incident documentation
Partner with engineering, broadcast operations, production teams, and vendors to align reliability practices with on-air and live-event requirements
Mentor teams on incident response best practices, reliability engineering concepts, and continuous improvement
Advise leadership on operational risk, system health, and reliability priorities for critical media platforms

Qualifications

Experience supporting media, broadcast, streaming, digital publishing, or other 24x7 customer-

facing platforms.

Experience building or scaling SRE organizations and operational maturity programs. Hands-on

experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Grafana, or similar

tools.

Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code and automation frameworks including Terraform,

CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies.

Experience leading reliability initiatives across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
Industry certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Engineer,

Azure Solutions Architect, ITIL, SRE Foundation, or equivalent.

Experience implementing AI-assisted operational intelligence, event correlation, or automated

incident response capabilities.
